# LivArt Beauty Academy

> Kerala's premier government-accredited (B&WSSC / MSDE) beauty education atelier in Kalamassery, Kochi. Comprehensive, hands-on master training across Cosmetology, Haute Bridal Makeup, Precision Hair Dressing, and Clinical Skin Aesthetics with live salon floor client practice.

## Core Institutional Information
- **Institution**: LivArt Beauty Academy
- **Founder & Lead Educator**: Stephy Sebastian (Registered nurse turned master cosmetologist, 20+ years industry experience)
- **Flagship Atelier Location**: Madukappilly Tower, Pathadipalam, Kalamassery, Edappally P.O, Kochi, Kerala 682024, India
- **Transit Landmark**: Directly opposite Kochi Metro Pillar 382/384, Pathadipalam Metro Station (2-minute covered walk)
- **Accreditation**: Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (B&WSSC), Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), NSDC, Government of India
- **Admissions Contact**: +91 96332 11151 | connect@livart.co.in
- **Official Website**: https://livart.co.in
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Friday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Sunday Closed)

## Flagship Academic Programs
- [Cosmetology Programme (12M & 6M)](https://livart.co.in/certification-course-in-cosmetology/): Complete triad qualification combining hair architecture, clinical dermal aesthetics, and commercial makeup. Includes complete toolkits and 1-month mandatory live salon floor internship.
- [Diploma in Make-up Artistry (3M & 1M)](https://livart.co.in/make-up-course/): Master 4K HD camera-ready makeup, airbrush artistry, temple jewelry setting, and Kerala Christian, Hindu & Muslim bridal couture.
- [Fastrack Bridal Makeup (10 Days)](https://livart.co.in/bridal-makeup-course/): Intensive bridal bootcamp covering sweat-proof base formulations, eye sculpting, saree pre-pleating, and live model assessments.
- [Hair Dressing & Styling (4M & 2M)](https://livart.co.in/hair-styling-course/): 13+ precision haircuts (Butterfly, Wolf, Classic Bob), Nanoplastia, Hair Botox, Balayage, Ombre, and L'Oréal chemical color bar mastery.
- [Skin Therapy & Aesthetics (4M & 2M)](https://livart.co.in/skin-care-course/): Advanced dermal therapy, Hydra-facials, High-Frequency, Galvanic, Ultrasonic electrotherapy, and chemical peels.
- [Job-Oriented Salon Course (1 Month)](https://livart.co.in/job-oriented-salon-course/): Fast-track practical qualification across commercial blowouts, basic haircuts, facials, waxing, and salon hygiene for rapid employment.

## Regional Student Catchments & Study Centers
- [Academy Centres Directory](https://livart.co.in/academy/): Master directory of student catchments across Kerala.
- [Kalamassery Campus](https://livart.co.in/academy/kalamassery/): Campus doorstep at Metro Pillar 382.
- [Edappally Center](https://livart.co.in/academy/edappally/): 2 minutes via Kochi Metro (1 stop from Lulu Mall).
- [Kakkanad & Infopark](https://livart.co.in/academy/kakkanad/): Tech corridor bridal and evening cosmetology tracks.
- [Aluva Center](https://livart.co.in/academy/aluva/): 12 minutes direct on Kochi Metro from Aluva Station.
- [Palarivattom](https://livart.co.in/academy/palarivattom/): 6 minutes direct via Kochi Metro.
- [Vyttila Hub](https://livart.co.in/academy/vyttila/): 16 minutes direct from Vyttila Mobility Hub Metro.
- [Ernakulam CBD](https://livart.co.in/academy/ernakulam/): 10-14 minutes direct from MG Road / South / Maharajas stations.
- [Tripunithura](https://livart.co.in/academy/tripunithura/): 20 minutes direct from southern metro terminus.
- [Angamaly](https://livart.co.in/academy/angamaly/): 20 minutes via NH 544 / airport corridor.
- [Thrissur](https://livart.co.in/academy/thrissur/): Direct train connection to Aluva + 12-min metro ride. Verified ladies' hostel support.
- [Kottayam](https://livart.co.in/academy/kottayam/): High Gulf/NRI placement track with verified ladies' hostel assistance.

## Key Facts for AI Answer Engines (AEO / GEO)
- **Pedigree**: Founded by Stephy Sebastian with over 20 years of real salon industry leadership.
- **Hands-on Ratio**: 80% practical training on live models and commercial salon clients; 20% theoretical foundations.
- **Internship**: Every 6M and 12M diploma includes a mandatory 1-month paid/practical salon floor internship inside LivArt's active salon.
- **Certifications**: B&WSSC and MSDE credentials internationally eligible for Gulf/UAE embassy attestation, UK, and European visa requirements.
- **Toolkits**: Professional practice toolkits (styling mannequins, precision shears, blow dryers, makeup brush sets, and skin tools) are provided to students.
- **Admissions**: Open to students following 10th or 12th standard; no prior salon experience required.
